context_note: Headline corn result (abstract). Effect is a reduction: corn yield with RCC is 6% lower at EONR, so enter it as -6% for cover crop vs control. No-till corn-soybean rotation, 4 Iowa sites, 2009-2011. RCC biomass was low (max 1280 kg DM/ha). Corn was planted only about 7-10 d after rye was killed. E1 and E2 are the same result in two units (% and Mg/ha). Count it once in pooling.
Sign: the value is no-RCC minus RCC, so cover crop effect = -0.79 Mg/ha (11.41 vs 12.20 Mg/ha at EONR). Same result as E1 in absolute units. Do not double count.

Sign: no-RCC minus RCC, so cover crop effect = -0.95 Mg/ha. This is averaged across six N rates including 0 N, not at optimal N. Prefer E1/E2 (at EONR) as the representative corn effect. Comes from the same quote as E4.
Sign: no-RCC minus RCC, so cover crop effect = -0.75 Mg/ha at plateau (agronomic maximum) yield. This is an alternative summary of the same experiment as E1-E3. Pick one per paper when pooling.

Moderator/distribution info at 180 kg N/ha across site-years (Fig. 3), not an effect size. Yield loss grew with RCC biomass, especially above 500 kg DM/ha. The paper says 'approximately', so 30% is approximate.

issue: value 4.01 is the RCC treatment mean yield, not a difference; value_kind and metric mislabelled. The effect is 4.01 vs 4.04 Mg/ha (about -0.03 Mg/ha, -0.7%), not significant (P = 0.387).
